alerts.title: Attention: Parents/Guardians of Special Education Students Born in 1999 & 2000
alerts.message:
Were you (or your student) born in 1999 or 2000 and received special education services through Belgrade School District?
In accordance with Montana and federal regulations, these records are maintained for 5 years past the end of services and are scheduled to be destroyed on September 30, 2026. You have the right to request and receive these records before they are destroyed.
To request your records, contact:
Jan Fowler at (406) 924-2491
